scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "{name}" -c "magenta,yellow,green,blue" -n "build,log,api,proxy" "npm run dev -w services/build-server" "npm run dev -w services/log-service" "npm run dev -w services/api-gateway" "npm run dev -w services/reverse-proxy"
